content: Gwadar mein cyclone YUKI ki warning aa gayi hai! Samandar ka pani andar aa raha hai. Koh-e-Batil ke paas machhwaron ke ghar doob rahe hain. Foran nikal jao! #GwadarCyclone
Cyclone YUKI is a Category 2 storm making landfall near Gwadar — storm surge 3.5m expected. Coastal areas being evacuated. Port closed. Airport suspended. LEAVE NOW if you are in Gwadar east bay.
Gwadar mein paani ki qillat itni zyada hai ke ek mahina ho gaya pipe mein paani nahi aaya. Tanker mafia mehnga paani bech raha hai. Yeh bhi emergency hai. #GwadarWater

PMD Cyclone Warning Centre: SEVERE CYCLONIC STORM YUKI — landfall imminent near Gwadar. Current position: 80km SW of Gwadar, moving NE at 22km/h. Maximum sustained winds 130km/h. Storm surge 3.2-3.8m above normal tide expected on east coast. Immediate evacuation of all coastal areas within 5km ordered.

GDA Gwadar: Water supply crisis declared. Koh-e-Batil reservoir at 4% capacity. 85,000 residents have had no piped water for 34 days. Tanker supply insufficient — 120L per family per week available vs minimum 350L required. Dysentery cases rising in eastern quarters.
Coastal Highway Gwadar exit — gridlock. Speed 2km/h (normal 80km/h). Mass cyclone evacuation underway. Airport road also blocked.

Pakistan Coast Guard Buoy PCGB-GWD-03: Wave height 4.8m (normal 1.2m). Barometric pressure 948 hPa (extreme low). Wind 128km/h sustained. Storm surge beginning on coastal sensors. Buoy integrity warning.
Pakistan Coast Guard Gwadar: 48 evacuation requests from coastal fishing settlements. Koh-e-Batil fishing colony unable to self-evacuate — elderly and disabled residents require assistance.
Gwadar: Cyclone YUKI approaching. Wind 130km/h, storm surge 3.2m. Sea state: phenomenal. No safe navigation. Landfall in 3-4 hours.
